title: Architecture: Add to Cart Button on Product Listing

components.name: Product Card Component
components.responsibility: Display product card with title, image, price, and Add to Cart button

components.name: Add to Cart Button
components.responsibility: Render button with state handling (enabled/disabled, loading, success)

components.name: Toast Notification
components.responsibility: Display feedback message after item added to cart

components.name: Cart Counter Header
components.responsibility: Display cart item count in header, update in real-time
components.updates: via Redux/Context API on cart change

components.name: Cart State Manager
components.responsibility: Manage global cart state, handle guest vs authenticated users

components.name: Local Storage Manager
components.responsibility: Persist cart for guest users in browser storage

flow_1_add_to_cart.name: User clicks Add to Cart
steps: 1. User clicks Add to Cart button on product card
4a. If guest user: Store item in LocalStorage
4b. If logged-in user: Send to backend /api/cart/add, save in database
5. On success: Update CartManager state (increment itemCount)
6. CartCounter component subscribes to state change, updates header count
7. Toast notification displays 'Item added to cart!'
8. Button state changes to 'Added ✓' for 2 seconds, then reverts

flow_2_out_of_stock.name: Product is out of stock
steps: 1. Product card receives inventory status from API/props
3. Add to Cart button disabled and text changes to 'Out of Stock'
4. Button styling changes (grayed out, cursor: not-allowed)

flow_3_cart_sync.name: Logged-in user cart sync
steps: 1. On app load, check if user is authenticated

frontend.notifications: React Toastify or custom Toast component

body.message: Product out of stock or invalid

error_handling.handling: Catch API error, show toast 'Failed to add item', button reverts to default state, retry option
API returns 400, show toast 'Product out of stock', button remains disabled
Redirect to login page, or fall back to guest local storage
Show warning toast, clear old cart items if possible, or prompt to login

responsive_design.desktop: Button inline on product card, standard toast at bottom right
responsive_design.tablet: Button inline, toast at bottom center
responsive_design.mobile: Button full-width or compact, toast at top of screen for better visibility

accessibility: Button has aria-label: 'Add product to cart'
Button has aria-disabled when out of stock
Toast is announced via aria-live region
Keyboard navigation: Tab to button, Enter/Space to activate
Color not sole indicator: use text + icon changes

unit_tests: AddToCartButton renders with correct initial state
AddToCartButton disabled when product out of stock
Toast displays success message on item added
integration_tests: Full flow: click button -> API call -> state update -> header counter updates -> toast shows
Guest user: cart saved to LocalStorage after add
Logged-in user: cart synced with backend after add
e2e_tests: User adds item to cart from product listing

security_considerations: Validate productId and quantity on server
Ensure user can only add to their own cart (auth check)
Sanitize any user input before storing in localStorage
